channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Miles Plumlee | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Miles Plumlee from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rich Cho on Miles Plumlee
item.description:
Chris Kroeger:Cho on concerns committing to Miles Plumlee:

“Not really. This is a big summer for him. We talked yesterday. He knows that.”

Rich Cho on Miles Plumlee, Apr 13, 2017. Source: Twitter @Kroeger.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Miles Plumlee
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Jason Kidd on Miles Plumlee:

“I think he's going to be fine in Charlotte. He'll get quality time. There's not 5 centers or 4 centers or 3 centers.”

Jason Kidd on Miles Plumlee, Feb 3, 2017. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: Rich Cho on Miles Plumlee
item.description:
Rich Cho on bringing in a lesser known Miles Plumlee for two veterans like Roy Hibbert and Spencer Hawes:

“Well, we felt like we needed more physicality on the frontline, and athleticism. And those are two things Miles can bring. Those are two of his strengths. He might not be as well known as the other guys [Hawes and Hibbert], but he has been in the league for a while. He’s 28-year-old. We’ve seen him a ton and I think he’s pretty well known within the NBA circle, maybe not to the fans out there as much, but he’s pretty well known within the NBA circle”

Rich Cho on Miles Plumlee, Feb 2, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Lionel Hollins on Miles Plumlee
item.description:
Hollins:

“I dont think he's helped at all with Miles Plumlee b/c Miles Plumlee plays in Phoenix”

Lionel Hollins on Miles Plumlee, Jan 10, 2015. Source: Twitter @rodboone.
